summary: Signed plate-reader qualification certificate from October 2008, with the control response checks, the qualification status and a next review date. Scanned copy with a received stamp and a handwritten note from the signer.

title_block.title: Plate Reader Qualification Certificate
title_block.subtitle: Routine qualification
lines: Instrument identity and qualification references: see signed instrument record

blocks.p: This certificate records routine qualification of the plate reader for primary potency and kinetic solubility work. The signed instrument record identifies the reader, optical settings, plate layouts and qualification run sheets covered by this release.

Control-response, optical-check and repeatability records are retained with the signed qualification run sheets. Consult those records for the methods, acceptance limits and observations; this certificate does not replace them.

The plate reader is qualified from the date of this certificate for the methods, optical settings and plate layouts covered by the signed qualification record. This release does not retrospectively qualify earlier runs.

list: Primary potency work within the qualified settings
Kinetic solubility work within the qualified settings

list.text: Confirm that the intended plate layout is covered before use

blocks.p: The next routine qualification is due at the start of the new year. Any repair or lamp change before then requires a new qualification before plates are read.
